ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the circuit is a 100 V DC power supply, with the upper end positive. The upper node is connected through a capacitor labeled C = 1 μF to the right branch; the right branch contains an inductor labeled L = 4 μH, and the lower end of the inductor is connected to the middle node. On the middle vertical branch there is a thyristor T, connected between the upper node and the middle node; the middle node is then connected through a 4 Ω resistor to the bottom loop. Reasoning: When the thyristor T is off and steady state is reached, the capacitor is charged to 100 V, the steady-state current of the inductor is 0, and the resistor current is also 0. After T is triggered on at t = 0, the upper node and the middle node are approximately short-circuited, so the 4 Ω resistor bears 100 V, producing a constant current 100/4 = 25 A, and this current flows through the thyristor. At the same time, the precharged capacitor and the inductor form a lossless LC transient loop. The LC angular frequency is ω = 1/sqrt(LC) = 1/sqrt((4 μH)(1 μF)) = 5 × 10^5 rad/s. The transient current amplitude is V0 sqrt(C/L) = 100 sqrt(1 μF/4 μH) = 50 A. According to the method stated in the problem, take the thyristor current as i_T(t) = 25 + 50 sin(ωt). The thyristor turns off when the current first falls to 0, so 25 + 50 sin(ωt) = 0, that is, sin(ωt) = -1/2. The first time this is satisfied after the initial positive-current interval is ωt = 7π/6. Therefore t = (7π/6)/(5 × 10^5) = 7.33038 × 10^-6 s = 7.33 μs.

method.method_draft: First establish initial conditions from the OFF steady state: the capacitor is charged to 100 V, the inductor current is 0, and the resistor current is 0. When T is fired, it shorts the top and middle nodes, so the 4 Ω resistor carries a constant 100/4 = 25 A load current through the thyristor. The precharged C and L now form a lossless series LC transient around the shorted thyristor path. Write the LC equation with v_C(0)=100 V and i_L(0)=0, giving angular frequency ω=1/sqrt(LC) and sinusoidal commutating current of amplitude V0 sqrt(C/L)=50 A. Combine this transient branch current with the 25 A resistor current using the sign determined by the branch orientation to get i_T(t)=25+50 sin(ωt). The conduction interval is the first positive time at which i_T(t)=0, i.e. sin(ωt)=-1/2 after the initial positive-current interval, so ωt=7π/6 and t=(7π/6)/ω, then convert to microseconds and round to 2 decimals.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：电路左侧是一个 100 V 直流电源，上端为正。上方节点通过一个标注为 C = 1 μF 的电容连接到右侧支路；右侧支路含有标注为 L = 4 μH 的电感，电感下端连接到中间节点。中间竖直支路上有晶闸管 T，连接在上方节点和中间节点之间；中间节点再通过 4 Ω 电阻连接到底部回路。

推理：在晶闸管 T 关断且达到稳态时，电容充电到 100 V，电感稳态电流为 0，电阻电流也为 0。t = 0 时 T 被触发导通后，上方节点和中间节点被近似短接，因此 4 Ω 电阻上承受 100 V，产生恒定电流 100/4 = 25 A，该电流流经晶闸管。与此同时，预充电的电容和电感形成无损 LC 暂态回路。LC 角频率为 ω = 1/sqrt(LC) = 1/sqrt((4 μH)(1 μF)) = 5 × 10^5 rad/s。暂态电流幅值为 V0 sqrt(C/L) = 100 sqrt(1 μF/4 μH) = 50 A。按题设方法取晶闸管电流为 i_T(t) = 25 + 50 sin(ωt)。晶闸管在电流首次降为 0 时关断，因此 25 + 50 sin(ωt) = 0，即 sin(ωt) = -1/2。初始正电流区间之后首次满足的是 ωt = 7π/6。因此 t = (7π/6)/(5 × 10^5) = 7.33038 × 10^-6 s = 7.33 μs。

method.method_draft: Determine the pre-switch initial conditions using DC steady state with T open: V_C(0^-)=100 V and I_L(0^-)=0. After T turns ON, replace T by an ideal short, so the resistor branch contributes a constant current I_R=100/4=25 A. In the Laplace domain, write KVL for the shorted series LC branch using the capacitor initial voltage term: 0 = V0/s + I_LC(s)/(Cs) + sL I_LC(s), with V0=100 V and initial inductor current zero. Solve for I_LC(s), invert it to obtain the sinusoidal LC current with amplitude 100 sqrt(C/L)=50 A and frequency 1/sqrt(LC). Apply KCL at the middle node to express thyristor current as the resistor current minus the LC branch current, yielding the zero-current condition equivalent to 25+50 sin(t/sqrt(LC))=0. Select the first valid zero after turn-on, t=(7π/6)sqrt(LC), and convert to microseconds to obtain the rounded duration.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中左侧是 100 V 直流电源，上端为正。上方节点连接到晶闸管 T 的上端，也通过一个标注为 C = 1 μF 的电容接到右侧支路。右侧支路中有标注为 L = 4 μH 的电感，电感下端接到中间节点。晶闸管 T 的下端也接到该中间节点，中间节点再通过 4 Ω 电阻接到电源下端。

再推理：T 关断且电路达到直流稳态时，电容相当于开路，电感电流为 0，因此 I_L(0^-) = 0。中间节点通过 4 Ω 电阻接到底端但无电流，故电容两端初始电压为电源电压，即 V_C(0^-) = 100 V。t = 0 后 T 导通，按理想短路处理。此时 4 Ω 电阻直接接在 100 V 电源上，电阻支路电流为 I_R = 100/4 = 25 A。短接后的 LC 支路作无阻尼振荡，按给定方法写其拉普拉斯域方程：0 = V0/s + I_LC(s)/(Cs) + sL I_LC(s)，其中 V0 = 100 V，初始电感电流为 0。由此得到 LC 电流为正弦形式，幅值为 V0 sqrt(C/L) = 100 sqrt(1 μF / 4 μH) = 50 A，角频率对应时间常数 sqrt(LC)。由节点电流关系，晶闸管电流为电阻支路电流与 LC 支路电流的代数组合，零电流条件按指定方法为 25 + 50 sin(t/sqrt(LC)) = 0。于是 sin(t/sqrt(LC)) = -1/2。导通后的第一个有效零点为 t/sqrt(LC) = 7π/6。sqrt(LC) = sqrt(4 μH × 1 μF) = sqrt(4 × 10^-12) = 2 × 10^-6 s。所以 t = (7π/6)(2 μs) = 7.33038 μs，四舍五入到 2 位小数为 7.33 μs。

The transient current amplitude is V0 sqrt(C/L) = 100 sqrt(1 μF/4 μH) = 50 A. According to the method stated in the problem, take the thyristor current as i_T(t) = 25 + 50 sin(ωt). The thyristor turns off when the current first falls to 0, so 25 + 50 sin(ωt) = 0, that is, sin(ωt) = -1/2. The first time this is satisfied after the initial positive-current interval is ωt = 7π/6. Therefore t = (7π/6)/(5 × 10^5) = 7.33038 × 10^-6 s = 7.33 μs.
